_readme: Manual corrections to OSM categorization, applied by 04-pois.ts.
The rulebook expects players to resolve miscategorizations with the '5 or more
Google Reviews' test, or by agreement. Neither works offline mid-game, so the
shipped layer files are the ruling and this file is where that ruling is made.
REVIEW THIS BEFORE GAME DAY. Both sides should agree on it in advance, because
an argument about whether a goat pen counts as a zoo is exactly what these
'exclude' drops a feature by exact name. 'note' is for humans only.

zoos.note: A goat-petting area on a industrial lot, not a zoo. Leaves the SF Zoo as the only entry, which makes the zoo MATCHING question always-yes — that is the correct outcome for San Francisco.

amusementParks.note: House of Air is a trampoline park; Boom & Bust is a mini-golf style course; the Skystar Wheel was a temporary installation. San Francisco has had no amusement park since Playland closed in 1972, so this category is genuinely NULL here.

aquariums.note: Steinhart (Cal Academy, Golden Gate Park) and Aquarium of the Bay (Pier 39). Both legitimate, and they give a clean east/west split.

golfCourses.note: All eight are real outdoor courses. Olympic Club straddles the county line; its clubhouse is inside SF so it stays.
